answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in wander, verified in grove, and jade names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 24 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 11 hours of verification and 22 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
